description: This file contains internal implementation details for safe mathematical operations, including templates for overflow checking, type traits, and operator wrappers, used within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CheckedAddFastOp
classes.description: Boilerplate for safe addition operation, unsupported if optimized math is unavailable.

classes.name: CheckedSubFastOp
classes.description: Boilerplate for safe subtraction operation, unsupported if optimized math is unavailable.

classes.name: CheckedMulFastOp
classes.description: Boilerplate for safe multiplication operation, unsupported if optimized math is unavailable.

classes.name: ClampedAddFastOp
classes.description: Boilerplate for clamped addition operation, unsupported if optimized math is unavailable.

classes.name: ClampedSubFastOp
classes.description: Boilerplate for clamped subtraction operation, unsupported if optimized math is unavailable.

classes.name: ClampedMulFastOp
classes.description: Boilerplate for clamped multiplication operation, unsupported if optimized math is unavailable.

classes.name: ClampedNegFastOp
classes.description: Boilerplate for clamped negation operation, unsupported if optimized math is unavailable.

classes.name: UnsignedOrFloatForSize
classes.description: Type trait to select unsigned integer or floating point type based on input type.

classes.name: NegateWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for unary negation supporting both integral and floating point types.

classes.name: InvertWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for bitwise inversion supporting integral types.

classes.name: AbsWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for absolute value supporting both integral and floating point types.

classes.name: MathWrapper
classes.description: Template to wrap math operations with specific operator implementations.

classes.name: ResultType
classes.description: Template to deduce result type for variadic math operations.

methods.name: NegateWrapper
methods.description: Negates a value, specialized for integral and floating point types.

methods.name: AbsWrapper
methods.description: Absolute value for integral and floating point types.
